identity.insurer_name: Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited
identity.eligibility_criteria: Indian residents aged 18 to 65 years. Lifelong guaranteed renewability.
identity.renewal_terms: Guaranteed lifelong renewal. No claim-based loading or penalty upon renewal.
identity.portability_conditions: Portability permitted under IRDAI regulations with at least 45 days application prior to policy expiration.
identity.geographic_availability: Pan-India across all empanelled hospital networks.

coverage.inpatient_hospitalization: Covered up to Sum Insured with no sub-limits on room rent, ICU, doctor fees, or nursing charges.
coverage.daycare_procedures: All 541+ daycare procedures covered where stay less than 24h is required.
coverage.domiciliary_hospitalization: Covered up to Sum Insured for home medical treatment exceeding 3 days.
coverage.home_healthcare: Covered for specified home nursing procedures following hospital discharge.
coverage.ayush_treatment: Inpatient treatment covered in registered AYUSH hospitals up to 100% of Sum Insured.
coverage.ambulance_cover: Road ambulance covered up to ₹3,000 per hospitalization. Air ambulance covered up to ₹5,00,000 per policy year.
coverage.organ_donor_expenses: Covered up to Sum Insured for harvesting organ from donor.
coverage.modern_treatments: Covered up to 100% of Sum Insured for advanced medical treatments including robotic surgery, oral chemo, and stem cell therapy.
coverage.maternity_cover: Not covered under standard MediCare variant (available under MediCare Premier variant).
coverage.opd_dental_vision: Dental treatment covered only if necessitated by accidental injury during inpatient care.
coverage.restoration_benefit: 100% automatic restore of Sum Insured once in a policy year upon complete exhaustion.
coverage.cumulative_bonus: Cumulative bonus of 50% for every claim-free year, up to a maximum of 100% of Sum Insured.
coverage.wellness_benefits: Tata AIG Wellness Program offers reward points redeemable against renewal premium and health vouchers.
coverage.critical_illness_rider: Second opinion for 11 critical illnesses included; optional Critical Illness lump-sum cover available.

permanent_exclusions: Cosmetic and plastic surgery unless required due to accident or burn
Substance abuse and alcohol addiction treatments
restrictions.room_rent_capping: No Room Rent Capping (Any room category including Single Private AC room). Zero proportionate deduction.
restrictions.icu_sub_limit: No Sub-limit on ICU charges (Actuals up to Sum Insured).

disease_sub_limits.Joint Replacement: Covered up to Sum Insured after 24 months waiting period

restrictions.zone_based_restrictions: Pan-India single pricing zone with zero co-payment irrespective of treatment city.
restrictions.pre_authorization_rules: Cashless pre-auth required 48 hours in advance for planned hospitalizations, within 24 hours for emergency.
restrictions.medical_necessity_clause: Treatment must be medically necessary, prescribed by a licensed practitioner, and adhere to recognised medical guidelines.
restrictions.non_payable_items: Consumables excluded unless optional Consumables Benefit rider is purchased.

premium.pricing_factors: Age of oldest member, sum insured tier, and multi-year tenure.
premium.tenure_discounts: 5% discount on 2-year tenure; 10% discount on 3-year tenure.
premium.installment_options: Annual, Half-yearly, and Quarterly premium payment modes supported.
premium.tax_benefits: Income Tax deduction under Section 80D up to ₹25,000 (individual/family) and ₹50,000 (seniors).
premium.medical_underwriting: Pre-policy health screening required for applicants above 45 years of age.
premium.cancellation_refund_terms: 100% refund during 15-day free-look period minus stamp duty. Short-rate scale upon cancellation thereafter.

claims.cashless_claim_procedure: Present Tata AIG Health Card at network hospital TPA/Cashless helpdesk -> Hospital submits pre-auth -> Claim approval within 2 hours -> Cashless discharge upon final billing.
claims.reimbursement_claim_procedure: Submit completed claim form with original medical bills, discharge summary, and pharmacy receipts within 30 days of discharge.
required_claim_documents: Itemized final hospital bill with receipt vouchers
Doctor prescriptions and diagnostic lab reports
KYC documents and cancelled bank cheque
claims.grievance_redressal_details: Toll-Free: 1800-266-7780 | Email: customersupport@tataaig.com | Grievance Officer: grievance.redressal@tataaig.com.
claims.tpa_support: Serviced via In-house TPA network and empanelled TPAs (Medi Assist, FHPL).

governing_regulations: IRDAI Master Circular on Operations and Allied Matters 2024
IRDAI Guidelines on Standardization of Health Insurance Contracts
